sentences.text: 30 Rock is an American satirical television sitcom created by Tina Fey that ran on NBC from October 11 , 2006 , to January 31 , 2013 .	Tina Fey	Tina Fey	NBC	NBC	satirical	satire	sitcom	sitcom

The series , loosely based on Fey 's experiences as head writer for Saturday Night Live , takes place behind the scenes of a fictional live sketch comedy show depicted as airing on NBC .	NBC	NBC	Saturday Night Live	Saturday Night Live	sketch comedy	sketch comedy

The series ' name refers to 30 Rockefeller Plaza in New York City , the address of the Comcast Building , where the NBC Studios are located and where Saturday Night Live is written , produced , and performed .	NBC Studios	NBC Studios (New York City)	New York City	New York City	New York	New York (state)	NBC	NBC	Saturday Night Live	Saturday Night Live	30 Rockefeller Plaza	30 Rockefeller Plaza	Comcast Building	30 Rockefeller Center
This series is produced by Broadway Video and Little Stranger , Inc. , in association with NBCUniversal .	Broadway Video	Broadway Video	NBCUniversal	NBCUniversal

30 Rock episodes were produced in a single-camera setup -LRB- with the exception of the two live episodes that were taped in the multiple-camera setup -RRB- , and were filmed in New York .	New York	New York (state)	single-camera setup	single-camera setup	live episodes	live television	multiple-camera setup	multiple-camera setup
The pilot episode premiered on October 11 , 2006 , and seven seasons followed .	pilot episode	Pilot (30 Rock)

The series stars Fey with a supporting cast that includes Alec Baldwin , Tracy Morgan , Jane Krakowski , Jack McBrayer , Scott Adsit , Judah Friedlander , Katrina Bowden , Keith Powell , Lonny Ross , John Lutz , Sue Galloway , Kevin Brown , Grizz Chapman , Maulik Pancholy , and Rachel Dratch .	Tracy Morgan	Tracy Morgan	Jane Krakowski	Jane Krakowski	Jack McBrayer	Jack McBrayer	Scott Adsit	Scott Adsit	Judah Friedlander	Judah Friedlander	Alec Baldwin	Alec Baldwin	Katrina Bowden	Katrina Bowden	Keith Powell	Keith Powell	Lonny Ross	Lonny Ross	John Lutz	John Lutz	Kevin Brown	Kevin Brown (actor)	Grizz Chapman	Grizz Chapman	Maulik Pancholy	Maulik Pancholy	Rachel Dratch	Rachel Dratch

Tonally , 30 Rock uses surreal humor to parody the complex corporate structure of NBC and its then parent company General Electric .	NBC	NBC	surreal humor	surreal humor	General Electric	General Electric
Television critic Todd VanDerWerff of The A.V. Club once remarked that it `` usually adopts the manic pacing of a live-action cartoon . ''	The A.V. Club	The A.V. Club
The show was influential in its extensive use of smash cuts : sudden , short cuts to unrelated scenes showing something the characters are briefly discussing .
30 Rock also became known for its dedication to making these extremely elaborate , once showing a set that took three days to build for only six seconds of video .

30 Rock received critical acclaim throughout its run , winning several major awards -LRB- including Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Comedy Series in 2007 , 2008 , and 2009 and nominations for every other year it ran -RRB- , and appearing on many critics ' year-end `` best of '' 2006-2013 lists .	Outstanding Comedy Series	Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Comedy Series	2007	59th Primetime Emmy Awards	2008	60th Primetime Emmy Awards	2009	61st Primetime Emmy Awards
On July 14 , 2009 , the series was nominated for 22 Primetime Emmy Awards , the most in a single year for a comedy series .	2009	61st Primetime Emmy Awards
Over the course of the series , it was nominated for 103 Primetime Emmy Awards and won 16 , in addition to numerous other nominations and wins from other awards shows .
Despite the high praise , the series struggled in the ratings throughout its run , something of which Fey herself has made light .

In 2009 , Comedy Central and WGN America bought the syndication rights to the show , which began airing on both networks on September 19 , 2011 ; the series also entered into local broadcast syndication on the same day .	2009	61st Primetime Emmy Awards	Comedy Central	Comedy Central	WGN America	WGN America	syndication	Broadcast syndication
Today , 30 Rock is regarded as a landmark series .
Its series finale in particular has been named as one of the greatest in television history by several publications .	series finale	Last Lunch
In 2013 , the Writers Guild of America named 30 Rock the 21st best-written television series of all time .	Writers Guild of America	Writers Guild of America
